title: Universal Wrap Strap spec and approved-member rules
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. The Wrap Strap is the fallback for rides without RAS anchors, and the highest FMEA risk is wrapping the wrong member (RPN 350). Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Specify the sling (length, choke geometry, sleeve, member diameter range) and write the approved-member rules for application guides (structural members only, never the primary restraint).
acceptanceCriteria: Rules make 'never the primary restraint' explicit with examples
Snap hook and 4 kN absorber requirement included
Merged as DRAFT only (banner intact); release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
